verdict.rationale: Microsoft Entra ID is an identity and access management service, not an agent or AI assistant, so plugging in MCP servers for it to consume their tools is a category error. The only MCP evidence (probe-4) concerns a Microsoft Learn MCP server, which is the server role. It shows nothing about Entra acting as an MCP client, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
